name: What is the process for designing and building a custom gazebo with your company?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for designing and building a custom gazebo with your company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision, needs, and budget. Next, we conduct a site evaluation to assess the best location and address any specific challenges. We then create detailed design plans and material selections for your approval. Once the design is finalized, we handle all necessary permits and proceed with construction, keeping you informed throughout the build to ensure the final product meets your expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process includes consultation, site evaluation, design creation, permit acquisition, and construction, with client approval at each stage.
